messages:
Tara: Heads-up thread for the joint announcement + marketplace onboarding with NVIDIA and AWS. We need SKU mapping, certified image references, co-branding copy, and a launch gating checklist by EOD Friday. Who can take which piece?
Leo: I'll own marketplace ingestion artifacts (SKUs + AMIs + SIG refs + GCP container). Need to know if we include specialized HW SKUs (e.g., a100, h100, graviton2).
Vik: From HW partner side: NVIDIA wants two SKUs: one optimized for A100 and one for H100 with quantization profiles called 'h100-optim' and 'a100-optim'. They also want a partner-case study blurb on the offer page.
Hannah: Legal note: co-branded blurb must be pre-approved. Marketplaces often require partner logos to be uploaded as vector assets and restrict pixel dimensions. Also need to attach partner MSA or approval email.
Tara: Good call. Can NVIDIA provide the logo pack and a short partner quote?
nvidia-partner-bot: NVIDIA assets uploaded: /partners/nvidia/logo-pack-v2.zip and draft quote: "Redwood + NVIDIA deliver high-throughput LLM inference". Approval pending legal.
Leo: For region and image mapping: x86 AMIs in us-east-1/us-west-2/eu-west-1, a100 AMIs in us-east-1/eu-west-1, h100 initially in us-east-1 only. Graviton builds available in us-east-1/us-west-2. I'll mark region-limited SKUs.
Vik: Also note: H100-optimized build uses fp8 kernels and is larger; marketplace needs an SBOM and security scan link. I'll push SBOM to artifacts and share link.
Hannah: Trial wording: "Try Redwood Inference with NVIDIA optimized runtimes free for up to 14 days. Cancel during trial to avoid charges. Trial may convert automatically to a paid subscription unless cancelled." Attach DPA link for EU.
Tara: Action items: (1) Leo = canonical SKU CSV + per-cloud mapping (due Thu EOD). (2) Vik = upload SBOM + partner quote + logo pack confirmation (due Wed). (3) Hannah = legal approval for quote & final trial/EULA copy + DPA link (due Thu AM). (4) marketplace-bot = run lint once assets are posted.
marketplace-bot: Lint scheduled. Will report missing DPA and logo vector issues after assets are uploaded.
Leo: Uploaded sample SKU CSV: ``sku,display_name,arch,hw_profile,regions,price_plan
redwood-nvidia-pro-a100,Redwood Inference - NVIDIA A100 Pro,x86_64,a100,us-east-1|eu-west-1,monthly``
Vik: SBOM posted: https://artifacts.redwood/partners/nvidia/rl_sbom_2026-03-25.json and security-scan: https://scans.redwood/reports/rl-2026-03-25-scan.html
Hannah: Legal uploaded approval email from partner and DPA link: https://legal.redwood/dpa-v2. Trial copy finalized.
marketplace-bot: Lint report: 2 warnings  missing vector logo in upload, 47  region-limited SKU needs explicit 'region_limited' flag. See /lint/1721112345-report.json
Tara: Great progress. I'll schedule a 20m gating call tomorrow 9:30 to triage the lint and confirm launch date. If you can't join, drop final assets in the checklist page and tag me. :rocket:
